description: This PHP source file defines the LicenseAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints to manage License entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting license records, and utilizes various API validation rules and Swagger annotations for documentation.

classes.name: LicenseAPI
classes.description: API class for managing license entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific license by its ID, throws exception if not found, and returns the license as a LicenseModel.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses with optional sorting and pagination, returning a collection result with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new license record based on provided parameters.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves license data, setting the name from request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing license based on provided ID and data.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring it is required, unique, and properly formatted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes licenses specified by a list of IDs, ensuring all IDs exist before deletion.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single license, primarily that the ID must be positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing licenses, mainly sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a license, notably requiring a valid 'name'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a license, including uniqueness check excluding the current record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting licenses, primarily requiring an array of IDs.
